entries.text: Combat Tools clears an ability's area off the map a few seconds after it's placed, or at the end of the turn. That's the Clear Placed Areas setting: turn it off, or give it longer with Seconds Before Clearing.

Combat Tools only counts a token as an enemy when its disposition is the opposite of yours, so a Neutral or Secret monster next to you gives no bane on a ranged strike. Targeting arrows show it: yellow means Neutral. Set the token, or its Prototype Token, to Hostile.
Minions that flashed red and never died, with Auto-Assign Damaged Minion on Death turned off, were fixed in Death Tracker 1.1.2. Update it from Foundry's setup screen.
A death picker that opened short after several quick hits, so Confirm refused it, was fixed in Death Tracker 1.1.2. Update it from Foundry's setup screen.
Battle Log 1.2.1 fixed a freeze after every log change once the Resource Log grew long, which could also pull the chat around while you scrolled. Update it from Foundry's setup screen.

Hide Start of Turn Rolls hides the chat message for a hero's start of turn roll. If you use Dice So Nice, its 3D dice still roll on screen: that's Dice So Nice, and its own settings control which rolls show dice.
Players only see how much a monster's Stamina changed, not its totals. The Director can show the totals with Show Monster Stamina to Players.
Squad turn markers that ignored the Combat Tracker's turn marker settings, or didn't come back after being turned off and on, were fixed in Combat Tools 1.2.2. Update it from Foundry's setup screen.

A flat start of turn gain, like an Elementalist's 2 Essence, that stayed in chat while rolled gains were hidden behind their log line, was fixed in Battle Log 1.3.0. Update it from Foundry's setup screen.

If you use Draw Steel Plus: it and Battle Log both put the speaker's name on typed chat lines, so every line showed it twice, which can look like doubled messages. Battle Log 1.3.3 shows one name. Update it from Foundry's setup screen.

Battle Log's Speaking As picker overrode Cautious Gamemaster's Pack's /desc and /ooc, so /desc lines read like speech. Battle Log 1.3.3 shows /desc as narration and leaves /as and /ooc as Cautious Gamemaster's Pack sets them. Update it from Foundry's setup screen.

Cautious Gamemaster's Pack's Speaker Mode settings could rename or strip the speaker of Draw Steel chat cards. Draw Steel: CTLib 1.2.2 gives cards their speaker back, alongside Battle Log 1.3.3. Update both from Foundry's setup screen.

Console errors that name Cautious Gamemaster's Pack, like "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'message')", come from that module on Foundry 14. They're harmless: chat cards still show and Battle Log keeps working.

With Polyglot, a line spoken in a language lost its "says:" line, so you couldn't tell who spoke. Battle Log 1.3.3 keeps it, and shows the runes faintly behind words you understand; click a line to swap them. Update it from Foundry's setup screen.

With Polyglot's Display Translations turned off, players could read languages they don't know. That's a Polyglot bug on Foundry 14; Battle Log 1.3.3 covers it until Polyglot's own fix is released. Update Battle Log from Foundry's setup screen, or keep Display Translations on.
